o.title: Settings
o.importHint: Excel, ODS or CSV. From Google Sheets: File › Download › Microsoft Excel. Kapi recognises months, categories, income, readings and bills.
o.impSafe: You can import again: existing rows are updated, not duplicated.
o.cloudHint: Connect Dropbox and/or Google Drive to sync your data across devices.
o.cloudPrivacy: 🔒 Kapibo has no server: data goes straight from your phone to your cloud.
o.dbxHint: You need a Dropbox app (free at dropbox.com/developers) with redirect URI {uri}.
o.gdHint: You need a Google OAuth Client ID (type “Web application”) with origin {origin}.
o.aiHint: With your own Claude API key, the text read from a receipt is tidied up by a small, cheap model. Photos stay on your phone.
o.aiHint2: The key stays on this device only.
o.wipeSure: Delete everything from this device? Your connected cloud isn't touched until you sync.
o.about: Home budget with Kapi. Free, no ads, your data stays yours.
o.update: A new version of Kapibo is available
ai.fail: Advanced reading failed: using the normal one
news.100: First release: receipts, payslips, bank statements, bills and meters; Excel import; Dropbox and Google Drive; charts and tips.
